column1: # CLI differential matrix (WP-18). One row per invocation; the generator
# (scripts/cli_matrix.py) and the replay test (tests/cli_matrix.rs) both read
# this file, so the two never drift apart.
# id     unique, also the golden basename (tests/cli_matrix/out/<id>.{out,err,code})
#        git          the copy is turned into a git repo with two commits
#        selfbaseline the tool first writes baseline.json for src/assert.py
# args   argv, split on spaces. Run with cwd = the workspace copy, so every
#        path in the output is relative and needs no path normalisation.
